mapper.select: SELECT book_no , book_name , book_coverimg , book_date , book_price , book_publisher , book_info FROM BOOK_TBL_06 ORDER BY book_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOOK_TBL_06 ( book_no , book_name , book_coverimg , book_date , book_price , book_publisher , book_info ) VALUES(#{bookNo}, #{bookName}, #{bookCoverimg} , #{bookDate} , #{bookPrice} , #{bookPublisher} , #{bookInfo})
mapper.select: SELECT b.book_no AS "book_no" , b.book_name AS "book_name" , SUM(r.rent_price) AS "rent_price" , COUNT(r.rent_status) AS "rent_status" FROM BOOK_TBL_06 b JOIN RENT_TBL_06 r ON (b.book_no = r.book_no) GROUP BY b.book_no, b.book_name
